name: Orb of Transmutation
description: Upgrades a [ItemRarity|Normal] item to a [ItemRarity|Magic] item with 1 modifier

name: Orb of Augmentation
description: Augments a [ItemRarity|Magic] item with a new random modifier

name: Regal Orb
description: Upgrades a [ItemRarity|Magic] item to a [ItemRarity|Rare] item, adding 1 modifier

name: Exalted Orb
description: Augments a [ItemRarity|Rare] item with a new random modifier

name: Chaos Orb
description: Removes a random modifier and augments a [ItemRarity|Rare] item with a new random modifier

name: Orb of Alchemy
description: Upgrades a [ItemRarity|Normal] or [ItemRarity|Magic] item to a [ItemRarity|Rare] item with 4 random modifiers

name: Orb of Annulment
description: Removes a random modifier from an item

name: Divine Orb
description: Randomises the numeric values of modifiers on an item

name: Vaal Orb
description: Modifies an item unpredictably and [Corrupted|Corrupts] it

name: Lesser Jeweller's Orb
description: Sets a Skill Gem to have 3 Support Gem Sockets

name: Greater Jeweller's Orb
description: Sets a Skill Gem to have 4 Support Gem Sockets

name: Perfect Jeweller's Orb
description: Sets a Skill Gem to have 5 Support Gem Sockets

name: Gemcutter's Prism
description: Improves the [Quality|quality] of a Skill Gem
